book.name: Mateos
book.title: Ramatua Yesus Tutui Malole Na tuka Mateos susura na

content: Lahenda ra tao sira atoran fo kati neuꞌ Manetualain pareta Na
Faiꞌ esa, boe ma lahenda Farisi ma mesen agama bubuaꞌ esa reme Yerusalem mai raneta ro Yesus.

Lahenda Farisi ra homu rahere hadas Yahudi nara. Ara ramanene rae, Yesus ana mana tuka dea nara raa-rinu ta tao tuka hadas sasafe limaꞌ a fa, de eteꞌ ao nara. Ara mai sale Yesus rae, “Ubeaꞌ taon, de O ana mana tuka dea mara raa-rinu, tehuu ta tao tuka hadas sasafe limaꞌ a fa? Ria nana ralena laka neuꞌ ita hadas bei-baꞌin!”
Tehuu Yesus nataa si nae, “Emi nana, tebe lahenda fo riꞌ dedea fekeꞌ ma tao fekeꞌ! Emi malena laka malelaꞌ Manetualain pareta Na, fo tuka noi bei-baꞌi mara hadas na.
Huu fo Manetualain pareta nae, ‘Fee hada-horomata neuꞌ ina-ama mara,’ Ma tamba bali nae, ‘Maneniko lahenda esa doꞌi ina-aman, muste huku mateꞌ ana.’

Manetualain nanori-nafada leo naꞌ, tehuu emi manori-mafada fekeꞌ bali. Huu fo emi mae, ‘Maneniko lahenda esa helu sakaꞌ fee hata-heton leo Manetualain neu, sona leo mae ina-aman doidoso raan seli boe oo, ana ta tulu-fali si pake ria hata-heton sira.’ Tehuu no emi manori-mafada leo naꞌ, emi tuꞌu-tapa heni Manetualain pareta Na, fo kati meniꞌ emi atoran mara.

Huu ria na, de bisinaaꞌ a Au afada ae, emi nana, lahenda fo dedea fekeꞌ ma tao fekeꞌ! Ria naraa no hata fo Manetualain mana nesi matan Yesaya duiꞌ memaꞌ neme uluꞌ mai laꞌe-neuꞌ emi! Huu fo Manetualain pake ni fo duiꞌ nae,

content.text: noi nai bafadoo peda na, tehuu daleꞌ taꞌa.
Leo mae ara tao leo naꞌ boe oo, mana dadi taaꞌ.
Ara ta tao daleꞌ neuꞌ Au,
huu fo ara tao daleꞌ noi neuꞌ lahenda dae-bafoꞌ a atoran na.’ ”

content: Hata tadaluꞌ a kalua neme lahenda dale na mai
Boe ma Yesus naloo na lahenda fekeꞌ rai naa, de nanori-nafada si nae, “Pasaꞌ matalolole ridoo mara, ela emi bisa bubuluꞌ!
Hata fo masoꞌ leo lahenda bafan daleꞌ neu, ria ta tao nakekeo-nakakanu lahenda. Tehuu hata fo kalua neme lahenda bafan daleꞌ mai, ria riꞌ tao nakekeo-nakakanu.”
Yesus ana mana tuka dea nara mai de rafada Ni rae, “Papa bubuluꞌ, do? Lahenda Farisi ra dale nara hanas a, nana huu ramanene Papa dedea-nafadam ria.”
Tehuu Yesus nataa nae, “Au Papa Ka nai nusatetu-ikutemaꞌ a neuꞌ ko tuꞌu-tapa heni lahenda fo ta nanori-nafada tuka Ria hihii-nanaun. Ria sama leoꞌ lahenda feꞌa heni parusa fo riꞌ ana ta selen fa.
De, bosoꞌ tao daleꞌ neuꞌ lahenda Farisi ra! Huu fo sira sama leoꞌ lahenda pokeꞌ natudu lahenda pokeꞌ a enoꞌ. Neuꞌ ko ara rame-rame tuda rala boloꞌ daleꞌ.”
Boe ma Petrus dedea nae, “Papa, mafada fee ami nasasama bisinaaꞌ a sosoa-raraan dei!”
Yesus nataa nae, “Emi bei ta bubuluꞌ boeꞌ?
Sosoa-raraan leo iaꞌ: Hata fo ita taa-tinun, masoꞌ nesiꞌ bafaꞌ ara, naroo leo teiꞌ ara daleꞌ neu, boe ma kalua leo kakus daleꞌ neu.
Tehuu hata fo kalua neme bafaꞌ ara mai, ria riꞌ tao nakekeo-nakakanu lahenda, losaꞌ Manetualain boe nahiaꞌ ana, ma ta nau sipoꞌ ana.
Huu fo hata tadaluꞌ dodouꞌ riꞌ kalua neme lahenda dale na mai! Sama leoꞌ: duꞌa-afi tadaluꞌ, naisa lahenda, hohoke, namanaꞌo, sakasii pepekoꞌ, ma dedea namumulu lahenda.
Hihii-nanauꞌ leo naꞌ ara, siꞌ tao rakekeo-rakakanu lahenda. Tehuu kalu noi riꞌ lahenda naa-ninu ma ta tao tuka hadas sasafe limaꞌ a, ria salaꞌ taꞌa.”
Ramatua Yesus tulu-fali inaꞌ esa fo ta lahenda Yahudi fa
Boe ma Yesus foa ela mamanaꞌ ria, de leo nusaꞌ fo riꞌ naneneaꞌ no kota Tirus ma kota Sidon.

Inaꞌ esa nai naa, neme nusaꞌ ria mai. Ria ta lahenda Yahudi fa. Faiꞌ fo namanene Yesus nai naa, boe ma ana mai hule teteaꞌ nae, “Mane Daud tititi-nonosin, ee! Kasian neuꞌ au dei! Huu fo au ana feto ka nitu ra heke raan, kasian, ana doidoso naan seli so.”
Tehuu Yesus neneeꞌ, ma ta nataa hata-hata esa boeꞌ. Boe ma ana mana tuka dea nara mai rafada Ni rae, “Papa, inaꞌ ia bou-bou tao tasibuꞌ. Malole lenaꞌ Papa mafadan fo naheoꞌ neme iaꞌ mai!”
Yesus nataa si nae, “Manetualain nadenu Au mai fo tulu-fali ita lahenda Yahudi nara, nana huu ara laꞌo sala, sama leoꞌ bibi-lopo manasala-manamopoꞌ. Ana ta nadenu Au uu tulu-fali lahenda fekeꞌ.”
Tehuu inaꞌ ria naneneaꞌ leo Yesus mai. Ana sundaꞌ undulaka na, ma hule tutulu-fafaliꞌ nae, “Ramatuaꞌ! Tulu-fali au dei.”

Tehuu Yesus tuꞌu dedeaꞌ nae, “Ta naraa hai anaꞌ ara nanaa-nininun, fo tuꞌu fee busa ra.” [Sosoa-raraan nanafuniꞌ nae, Yesus muste tulu-fali Ria lahenda Yahudi nara dei, besaꞌ ko bisa tulu-fali lahenda fekeꞌ.]

Tehuu inaꞌ ria balas nae, “Tebe, Papa! Tehuu busa ra rahani nai mei a fiki dale na. Sira boe raa hata fo riꞌ tuda nemeꞌ anaꞌ ara bika nara mai.” [Sosoa-raraan nae, faiꞌ fo anaꞌ ara raa, busa a boe naa. Leo mae Yesus tulu-fali Ria lahenda nara, tehuu Ria boe muste relu-natanae lahenda fekeꞌ.]
Yesus namanene leoꞌ na, boe ma nafada nae, “Awii! Mama namahere tebe-tebe neuꞌ Au, oo! De mama fali leo, te hata fo mama hule a, dadi memaꞌ so!” Boe ma ana fali, te nita ana na teꞌe na aon so.
Ramatua Yesus puli naa lahenda dodouꞌ
Basa de Yesus no ana mana tuka dea nara foa ela mamanaꞌ ria, ara laꞌo tuka dano Galilea suu na. Ara ae leo leteꞌ esa lain reu, de Yesus natuuꞌ fo nanori-nafada si.

Boe ma lahenda dodouꞌ leo Ria mai. Ara roo lahenda ei helaꞌ, lahenda pokeꞌ, lahenda lukuꞌ, lahenda pakanaaꞌ, ma lahenda kamahedis fekeꞌ boe. Ara raneneaꞌ lahenda kamahedis sira reuꞌ Yesus ei Na. Boe ma Ana puli naa si.

Lahenda makadotoꞌ sira rita leoꞌ na, boe ma ara heran. Ara bei dea rae, “Ae! Kahereꞌ naan seli, oo! Lahenda ei helaꞌ, bisa laꞌo natetu. Lahenda pokeꞌ bisa nita-dae. Lahenda lukuꞌ bisa laꞌo. Ma lahenda pakanaaꞌ bisa dedea so! Tantu Manetualain riꞌ nonoi-tataon ia. Ria nana, Ramatuaꞌ fo riꞌ neme fai a ulu na mai, ita bei-baꞌin doꞌo-tabe Ni a.”
Ramatua Yesus nahao lahenda rifun haa

Basa faiꞌ hida, boe ma Yesus naloo na ana mana tuka dea nara de nae, “Au kasian neuꞌ basa lahenda makadotoꞌ ia ra. Ruma reme dae dooꞌ mai, nate ara rabua faiꞌ telu ian, de nanaaꞌ taꞌa so. Malole lenaꞌ ara bosoꞌ fali no tei rouꞌ. Bosoꞌ losa ara saparao rai eno taladaꞌ.”
Tehuu Yesus ana mana tuka dea nara rataa rae, “Papa! Ia nana mamana lino-nees, dooꞌ a neme koroꞌ a mai. Mae tao lee oo, ita ta bisa tahao lahenda makadotoꞌ ia ra fa.”
Tehuu Yesus natane si nae, “Emi manuu roti hida?” Ara rataa rae, “Hituꞌ a! Ma ikaꞌ baiꞌ!”
Boe ma Yesus nadenu lahenda sira basa si fo ratuuꞌ reuꞌ dae a.
Ana hai na roti kahituꞌ ara ma ikaꞌ sira, boe ma Ana hule makasi neuꞌ Manetualain. Boe ma Ana tetebi si, de fees reuꞌ ana mana tuka dea nara, fo ara babati fee basa lahenda sira.
Ara raa losaꞌ rabete. Basa de rabubua ra nanaa lenaꞌ ara henu lapaneu hitu.
Lahenda fo raa a, basa si bate touꞌ rifun haa. Bei ta rekeꞌ inaꞌ ma anaꞌ ara.
Basa de Yesus nadenu lahenda makadotoꞌ sira fali. Boe ma Ana saꞌe ofaꞌ fo ara leo nusa Magadan reu.

footnotes.text: Ta bubuluꞌ matetuꞌ mamanaꞌ ia nai bea fa. Duduiꞌ dedea Yunani fekeꞌ a duiꞌ nae, ‘Magdala’. Fekeꞌ bali duiꞌ nae, ‘Magdalan’.
